def csv_rows(text):
    rows = []
    row = []
    field = []
    i = 0
    n = len(text)
    in_quotes = False
    field_started = False

    while i < n:
        c = text[i]

        if in_quotes:
            if c == '"':
                if i + 1 < n and text[i + 1] == '"':
                    field.append('"')
                    i += 2
                    continue
                else:
                    in_quotes = False
                    i += 1
                    continue
            else:
                field.append(c)
                i += 1
                continue
        else:
            if c == '"' and not field_started:
                in_quotes = True
                field_started = True
                i += 1
                continue
            elif c == ',':
                row.append(''.join(field))
                field = []
                field_started = False
                i += 1
                continue
            elif c == '\r':
                if i + 1 < n and text[i + 1] == '\n':
                    i += 2
                else:
                    i += 1
                row.append(''.join(field))
                rows.append(row)
                row = []
                field = []
                field_started = False
                continue
            elif c == '\n':
                row.append(''.join(field))
                rows.append(row)
                row = []
                field = []
                field_started = False
                i += 1
                continue
            else:
                field.append(c)
                field_started = True
                i += 1
                continue

    # Handle the last field/row if the text doesn't end with a line ending
    if field or row:
        row.append(''.join(field))
        rows.append(row)

    return rows

def csv_rows(text):
    rows = []
    current_row = []
    current_field = []
    in_quotes = False
    i = 0
    n = len(text)
    
    while i < n:
        char = text[i]
        
        if in_quotes:
            if char == '"':
                # Check for doubled quote (escaped quote)
                if i + 1 < n and text[i + 1] == '"':
                    current_field.append('"')
                    i += 2
                    continue
                else:
                    # End of quoted field
                    in_quotes = False
                    i += 1
                    continue
            else:
                # Any character inside quotes is literal
                current_field.append(char)
                i += 1
                continue
        else:
            if char == '"':
                # Start of quoted field
                in_quotes = True
                i += 1
                continue
            elif char == ',':
                # End of field
                current_row.append(''.join(current_field))
                current_field = []
                i += 1
                continue
            elif char == '\r':
                # Handle CRLF or CR
                if i + 1 < n and text[i + 1] == '\n':
                    # CRLF
                    current_row.append(''.join(current_field))
                    current_field = []
                    rows.append(current_row)
                    current_row = []
                    i += 2
                    continue
                else:
                    # CR alone
                    current_row.append(''.join(current_field))
                    current_field = []
                    rows.append(current_row)
                    current_row = []
                    i += 1
                    continue
            elif char == '\n':
                # LF
                current_row.append(''.join(current_field))
                current_field = []
                rows.append(current_row)
                current_row = []
                i += 1
                continue
            else:
                # Regular character
                current_field.append(char)
                i += 1
                continue
    
    # Handle the last field and row
    if current_field or current_row:
        current_row.append(''.join(current_field))
        rows.append(current_row)
    
    return rows
